title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1982-09-18

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with a solid first set but noticeably thin bass, delivering an overall decent but uneven show.
ai_review.review: The recording is generally clear and pleasant, though several listeners note the bass is almost absent, making the mix feel thin. The first set receives consistent praise for its energy and Jerry’s guitar work, while the second set is seen as a step up from earlier versions but still not on par with surrounding shows. Overall it’s a respectable performance of the era, hampered mainly by low‑end balance issues.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is average to good (solid first set, mixed second set) while recording quality is decent but suffers from a weak bass mix; the weighted calculation yields ~3.6 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall sound and pleasant balance, but bass levels are very low, making the mix feel thin for some listeners.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set praised as strong; second set considered an improvement over previous versions but still not as exciting as adjacent shows.

band_member_comments.Jerry: First‑set guitar work highlighted positively in several reviews.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass noted as too low in the mix, reducing overall impact.
